correctness.rationale: An independent set containing both bipartition sides lies in one matched block A_i∪B_i, so each mixed colour is contained in a single such block. Two side-only colours on the same side cannot both have a CDV. If both types of side-only colours are present, a mixed class cannot have a CDV; if exactly one side-only colour remains, each opposite-side block must carry a mixed colour and its same-index side-only vertices cannot see it, contradiction. Thus all b-colourings are exactly the two side classes or one mixed class per paired block. r>=3 ensures nonempty cross-neighbors, making every vertex a CDV in both patterns. This gives the exact profiles, counts and coordinatewise realization. Independent direct exhaustive proper-colouring enumeration checked examples r=3 sizes (1,1,1),(2,1,1) and r=4 equal unit sizes, recovering respective named counts 2/6 and 2/24 with correct profiles. Boundary r=2 disconnected excluded.
